🎬 Revenge (2017) — Action, Thriller
Revenge (2017) is a brutal French action thriller that follows Jen, a young woman whose weekend getaway with her wealthy boyfriend takes a horrifying turn. After being betrayed and left for dead, Jen refuses to remain a victim and sets out to confront the men responsible.
As she fights to survive, Jen transforms from someone caught in a dangerous situation into a determined survivor. Her journey becomes a relentless pursuit of justice, forcing her enemies to face the consequences of what they have done.
The film explores themes of survival, revenge, empowerment, and justice while challenging the idea that vulnerability means weakness. Jen's transformation becomes the heart of the story as she takes control of her own fate.
More than just a revenge thriller, Revenge is a story about resilience and refusing to let someone else's actions define your future. 🔥
💬 Do you think revenge can ever truly bring justice, or does it only create more consequences? Let us know in the comments! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Revenge is a 2017 French action-thriller film written and directed by Coralie Fargeat in her feature directorial debut, and starring Matilda Lutz, Kevin Janssens, Vincent Colombe, and Guillaume Bouchède. The plot follows a young woman who is raped and left for dead in the desert by three men, where she recovers and seeks vengeance upon them. Revenge had its world premiere on 11 September 2017 at the 42nd Toronto International Film Festival, as part of the Midnight Madness section. The film was released theatrically in France on 7 February 2018 by Rezo Films and received acclaim from critics.
